provenance.status: Primary-video-reviewed conceptual exterior model; inferred elevations and details, not BIM or construction documentation.

primary_visual_review.method: Thirteen sampled frames across the full tour; broad massing comparison, double-height timber entry refinement, and corresponding camera presets. Not calibrated photogrammetry or continuous video/audio analysis.

provenance.source_priority: Primary architectural video controls visible exterior character and massing review. PDF plans control layouts and dimensions. Still renders are supplementary references; unseen geometry remains inferred.
provenance.basis: Four supplied architectural plans registered to common lift shaft; source masonry vectors retained, plan-traced floorplates/closure and reference-inspired exterior infill added.
provenance.axes: Metres, Y up; X page right, Z page down; lift shaft center is shared X/Z origin.
assumptions: Vertical dimensions are user-authorized visualization assumptions, not measured elevations.

Two-storey western garden pavilion and taller eastern/street wing follow terrace/enclosed-room differences in plans. Reference views have uncertain grade/join relationships; no exact photo match is claimed.
Roof overhangs, rounded corners, 0.34m visual fascias, wood soffits, full-height glass heads, stone piers, frames and rails are conceptual inferred elevation details.

Slab outlines and void cuts are manually traced from plan sheets; courtyard openings persist through opaque surfaces. Puja/entrance double-height cutouts occur at first floor, with translucent rooflights only at second-floor roof datum.
Basement registration is provisional across drawing revisions; sunken lounge, planting, entry canopy/carport and furniture are reference-inspired landscape choices, not measured plan features.

Interior walls are retained CAD geometry with targeted ground service/bedroom closure; no generic replacement room layout. Small doors, stairs, wet-area details and coordinated construction junctions are not fully reconstructed.
provenance.materials: Untextured physically based beige stone-look masonry, warm wood-look soffits, bronze/charcoal frames and transparent glass; no image billboards.
